{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("First 10 revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue values with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Sample of values with commas
print("Sample with commas:", sales.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head(5).tolist())"}
